script_nghe: The class is on Wednesday. It starts at six fifteen and finishes at eight o’clock. You’ll be in room B12 — that’s B for Bravo, one two. And your first lesson is on the fifteenth of September.

phan.noi_dung:
**COURSE TIMETABLE**

- Class day: **1** ____________
- Start time: **2** ____________
- Finish time: **3** ____________
- Room number: **4** ____________
- First lesson date: **5** ____________ September

> Tom works in a bank. He gets up at half past six every morning and leaves home at half past seven. His office opens at eight and closes at five. He has lunch at twelve. On Saturdays he doesn’t work, but he studies Spanish in the evening. His birthday is on 3rd November and he always has a party with his friends.

**True / False / Not Given (6–8):**
6. Tom leaves home at seven o’clock.
7. Tom works on Saturdays.
8. Tom speaks Spanish very well.

**Hoàn thành câu (9–11):**
9. Tom’s office opens at ____________.
10. He studies Spanish on Saturday ____________.
11. His birthday is in ____________.

Viết **50–60 từ** về lịch một ngày làm việc của bạn, dùng ít nhất 4 mốc giờ.
*Tiêu chí: at/on/in dùng đúng (3đ) · cách nói giờ đúng (1đ) · viết hoa thứ/tháng (1đ).*

1. What time do you usually get up?
1. When is your birthday?
1. What do you do at the weekend?

writing.de_tom_tat: Viết 50–60 từ về lịch một ngày làm việc, dùng ít nhất 4 mốc giờ.
writing.bai_mau: I get up at six o'clock every morning. I start work at eight, and I have lunch at half past twelve. In the afternoon I usually have meetings. I finish work at six in the evening. On Friday I leave earlier, at five, because I go to English class.

cham_diem.vi_sao: at six o'clock (giờ cụ thể) · in the afternoon / in the evening (buổi) · on Friday (thứ). Đúng cả 3 loại.
half past twelve · six o'clock — đúng cách nói giờ Anh-Anh.
Friday viết hoa. Tiếng Việt không viết hoa thứ nên rất dễ quên.

dang_hoc: Quy tắc gọn: at + giờ · on + thứ/ngày · in + buổi/tháng/năm.
Ngoại lệ phải thuộc: at night (không phải in night), at the weekend.
half past twelve = 12h30 · a quarter to ten = 9h45 · a quarter past three = 3h15.

speaking.de_tom_tat: What time do you usually get up? / When is your birthday? / What do you do at the weekend?

cau_tra_loi.hoi: What time do you usually get up?
cau_tra_loi.mau: I usually get up at six, or half past six at the weekend.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: Thêm ngoại lệ cuối tuần làm câu tự nhiên, không máy móc.

cau_tra_loi.mau: It's on the twelfth of March. It's in spring, so the weather is usually nice.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: Ngày phải dùng số thứ tự: the twelfth, không phải “the twelve”.

cau_tra_loi.hoi: What do you do at the weekend?
cau_tra_loi.mau: I usually sleep in on Saturday morning. Then I meet friends for coffee, and on Sunday I stay home and study English.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: Kể theo trình tự thời gian là cách dễ nhất để nói dài mà không bí.

cham_diem.vi_sao: Dùng “Then…”, “and on Sunday…” để nối liền mạch.
twelfth /twelfθ/ — cụm phụ âm cuối khó, phải bật ra chứ không nuốt.

meo_noi: Số thứ tự hay dùng: first, second, third, fifth, twelfth, twentieth, thirty-first.
at the weekend (Anh-Anh) / on the weekend (Anh-Mỹ) — chọn một rồi dùng nhất quán.
